content:
Noah P: Quick thread — proposing an iteration: collapse the autoscale controls into a single compact row for dashboards. Need decisions on tappable hit areas, slider precision, and burst CTA wording.

Lina C: Compact is good. Main ask: make the numeric hit targets >=44px for touch. Otherwise people miss the steppers.

Ethan (FE): Will do. Plan: visible +/- steppers with 44px min touch, numeric input in the middle. Arrow keys adjust by step; Shift+arrow = +10.

Mira (a11y): a11y checklist: 1) inputs must have accessible labels (visually hidden ok). 2) sliders need aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow. 3) steppers need aria-controls and aria-labels. 4) modal must trap focus.

Noah P: Slider precision: default coarse = 5% steps. Add a small inline "Fine" toggle (icon-only) that swaps to 1% steps. Is icon-only discoverable enough?

Lina C: If it's icon-only provide tooltip "Fine precision" and expose text on hover/focus. Also increase hit area to meet 44px.

Ethan (FE): Implementation note: toggle will be a button with aria-pressed, and change the input's step attr. Will animate the label briefly when toggled to hint behavior.

Noah P: Burst modal wording: current "Enable burst" too vague. Proposal: "Enable burst: +{n} GPUs for up to {t} minutes. Billed while active." CTA: "Enable burst (+{n}, {t}m)". Secondary: "Don't enable". Thoughts?

Mira (a11y): CTA must be explicit. Avoid generic "Confirm". Modal: trap focus, Esc closes, aria-describedby points to billing copy. Announce estimated cost with role=status.

Lina C: Also add an "Auto-revert" checkbox: label "Auto-revert after burst period" with tooltip explaining cooldown.

Ethan (FE): I'll prototype the compact row + modal. Small code note I'll share: use <div role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="75"> for screen readers.

build-bot: Prototype branch created: github.com/redwood/ui/tree/compact-row-burst (ethan/compact-row) :rocket:

Noah P: Great. Action items: Ethan 1 prototype, Mira 1 full aria attr list and sample markup, Lina 1 final microcopy tweaks. Closing after prototype review.
